disambiguation: Not an audio library or player for existing sound files; it generates speech from note text.
extras: Free and MIT-licensed, but generation uses a Cartesia account with a free tier (20,000 credits/month) and paid plans; note text is sent to Cartesia, the API key is stored in local storage (not a keychain), and failed transfers can consume credits with no automatic retry.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to listen to notes aloud or save them as audio for offline playback.

relations.evidence: Generating audio requires your own Cartesia account and API key.

summary: Text-to-speech plugin that reads notes aloud through Cartesia and saves them as MP3 files for offline listening.
